checks.details: NEAR AI z-ai/glm-5.3-flash: weighted total 90 vs threshold 70

scores.rationale: All required topics are covered—function-call keys, allowances, method restrictions, removing full-access keys, sub-account creation and deletion, and key rotation—plus useful extras like auditing, testnet validation, and multi-sig.

Nearly every item includes a concrete near-cli-rs command or near-api-js call with a stated risk, though a few commands appear slightly outdated (e.g., --masterAccount flag, add-key allowance format) and item 10 lacks any concrete command or call.

The checklist is numbered with clear titles and rationales, opens and closes with a helpful summary, and links five official NEAR documentation pages, though the JSON duplicates the section content rather than adding structure.
